raw_blocks: From homes to headquarters, Armstrong offers industry-leading ceiling and wall solutions that are engineered to provide superior acoustics, aesthetics, and sustainability.
Armstrong offers industry-leading ceiling and wall solutions that are engineered to provide superior acoustics and aesthetics.
High-performance solutions from mineral fiber to wood deliver design-forward spaces.ㅤㅤㅤㅤ
Acoustical wall panels, wood grilles, and resilient partitions to define and enhance any space.ㅤㅤ
Acoustical, drywall, and structural grid systems built for durability, fire safety, and easy installation.
AXIOM extruded aluminum trims, perimeters, and transitions for crisp edges and seamless ceiling details.
Metal ceiling tiles, panels, planks, clouds, and curves in standard, custom, and one-of-a-kind designs.
Hardware, clips, adhesives, and finishing products to complete your ceiling and wall installation.
Easy-access suspended ceilings for basements, home theaters, and utility spaces — with moisture and mold-resistant options.
